band.unit: $/m2 of net cladding face area (window and door openings deducted)
band.basis: Sum of the nine components above, no part counted twice: 421-600 (ACP system, per the stated inclusion assumption) + 21.2-26.9 + 7.3-10.0 + 17.2-21.8 + 7.3-9.1 (flashings) + 19.8-28.9 (lift) + 15-32 (allowances, 2.9-4.4% of the band). Total for the nominal 450 m2: $229,050 low, $328,050 high, centre about $279,000. Auckland rates, NZD, GST exclusive, margin, preliminaries, design, consent fees, producer statements, air barrier, fire stopping and scaffold excluded exactly as the scope lists. The band's width is one question - whether the QV proprietary-wall-cladding-system row carries the 40mm drained cavity layer (top hats and thermally broken brackets) or not; at the low end it does, at the high end it does not.

Sum of the seven components per m2, Auckland, GST exclusive, QV CostBuilder rows with stated adjustments plus minor allowances: 472+76.3+15.1+0.9+3.3+5.0+2.0 = 574.6 low; 618+109.4+17.8+2.0+6.7+10.0+4.0 = 767.9 high. Allowances carry only ~2-3% of the band, so the band is driven by cited rows. Total for the nominal 450 m2: low 574.6 x 450 = 258,570 (~259,000); high 767.9 x 450 = 345,555 (~346,000); midpoint 671.3/m2 x 450 = ~302,000. Scope is exactly as pinned: openings deducted, 266 lm flashings included, 6-week boom lift amortised, no prelims, margin, design, consent fees, substrate works, fire-stopping, windows or perimeter scaffold. QV rows are UNREVIEWED so the band is deliberately wide, and it is a cost-plan band, not a certified price.

band.unit: $/m2 of net cladding face area (450 m2, openings deducted)
band.centre: $715/m2 and $322,000 total for 450 m2 (Auckland, GST exclusive)
band.basis: Sum of distinct components, no double counting. ACP cassette system 227,250 (low) to 298,800 (high) from QV row d522ac53...:t1:r9 with a stated +20%/+45% specification adjustment and Paneltec NZ web corroboration. Flashings 35,743 to 41,190 from QV aluminium flashing rows 528b0345...:t21:r17/r18/r19 with stated +50% to +100% gauge adjustments for 3mm. Boom lift 8,010 to 11,214 from QV row 253b838a...:t8:r15. Lift delivery/fuel 900 to 1,800 allowance. Drawings/set-out/clean/waste 6,300 to 12,600 allowance. Low total 278,203 (= 618/m2); high total 365,606 (= 813/m2). Allowances are about 3% of the total, well under one third, and both main drivers (panel system, access) and the flashings rest on cited QV rows or a fetched page. Band is wide because QV's own ACP family spread is 421-920/m2 and the QV ACP attributes are undeclared. Excludes GST, preliminaries, margin, design, consent, rigid air barrier, substrate repair, cavity fire barriers, windows/doors/louvres/soffits/balustrades/roofing, structural steel, scaffold and edge protection, traffic management, and PS1/PS3/facade-engineer producer statements.
